description.value: Merridale Eatery is the farmhouse dining room of Merridale Cidery & Distillery, a family-owned, woman-led farm operation that has been crafting ciders and spirits in the Cowichan Valley for over 30 years. The eatery serves farm-fresh comfort food designed to pair with their house-made ciders, spirits, and artisanal sodas on a 20-acre working orchard. Cyclists will find a relaxed pub-style setting with heated patio and courtyard seating, plus a farm store stocked with award-winning ciders, spirits, and local gifts.

address.value: 1230 Merridale Road, Cobble Hill, BC V8H 1A1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Merridale Eatery is the dining component of Merridale Cidery & Distillery, a real and actively operating farm destination in Cobble Hill (Cowichan Valley) — not Sidney as the OSM community field states. The website provides address (1230 Merridale Road, Cobble Hill) and phone (250-743-4293) absent from OSM tags. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the business address is 1230 Merridale Road, Cobble Hill — roughly 30+ km away on the other side of the Saanich Peninsula. The OSM node may be misplaced or assigned to the wrong community.
OSM name 'Merridale Eatery' refers only to the eatery component; the full business is 'Merridale Cidery & Distillery'. A separate OSM node for the broader farm destination may exist or be warranted.
OSM tags contain no phone or address; both were sourced from the website and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating farm eatery and cidery destination with a current website, reservation system, and upcoming events. A natural stop for touring cyclists in the Cowichan Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: The farm also offers yurt accommodations and guided tastings/tours, which may warrant separate WWC directory entries. Dogs are welcome on leash on the heated patio and courtyard.
